prefix.sampling: first accepted sentences from the deterministic compressed byte prefix

normalization.wikitext: conservative regex cleanup; templates, references, tables, links, HTML, and formatting markup removed
normalization.tokenizer: Unicode letters with optional internal apostrophe/hyphen, plus numeric tokens

cooccurrence.neighbour: directed adjacent token bigrams; identical-token edges omitted
cooccurrence.sentence: unique unordered token pairs per sentence
cooccurrence.association_score: Dice coefficient multiplied by 100, stored as significance for Leipzig-compatible schema
